worked_solution:
Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{\pi /6}^{\pi /3}(-{csc}^{2}⁡x)\,\text{d}x & =\operatorname{cot}⁡x\,{|}_{\pi /6}^{\pi /3} \\  & =cot\,(\frac{\pi }{3})-cot\,(\frac{\pi }{6}) \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}-\sqrt{3} \\  & =\frac{1-3}{\sqrt{3}} \\  & =-\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}.\end{aligned}
$$
